# PhySoc IIT Kharagpur — Complete Society & Department Documentation

## Identity & Mission
The Physics Society (PhySoc), Department of Physics, IIT Kharagpur is the official student and academic body fostering research culture, theoretical intuition, computational modeling, and collaborative scientific discourse among physics students and faculty at IIT Kharagpur.

- Official Domain: https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app
- Institution: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT KGP)
- Department: Department of Physics

---

## Complete Site Map & Directory

### 1. Home Page (`https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app/`)
- Hero section highlighting the society mission and core identity.
- Featured highlights: Recent symposiums, upcoming colloquia, and community initiatives.
- Instant search engine across all society pages and academic resources.
- Quick links to resources, event calendars, and departmental notices.

### 2. About Us (`https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app/about/`)
- History and origins of PhySoc at IIT Kharagpur.
- Faculty advisors and guiding professors from the Department of Physics.
- Student leadership, office bearers, executive council, and sub-committees.
- Mission statement: Have fun with physics, don't just read the formulas and theorems. We are a friendly place to talk about not only the different specialized areas, but the beauty of Physics itself.

### 3. Events(`https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app/events/`)
- **Physic Talk **:Physics Talk is a series of informal, interactive talks with researchers, distinguished professors and visiting scholars. Departing from the classic seminar format, these sessions are dedicated to “Physics itself” – a blend of conceptual discussions with personal journeys of the speakers. These talks are designed to be very accessible, talking about what inspired our guests to go into science and what the life of a researcher really entails. It is a perfect atmosphere for everyone especially freshers to get inspiration and valuable guidance for their own path in physics.
- **Competitions**:PhySoc runs a busy program of activities throughout the year to bring our department together. Whether you are looking for the intellectual challenges of our Integration Bee and Project Showcase, or if you prefer friendly chess tournaments and sports such as badminton, there is something for everyone. We encourage everyone in the department to get involved – including our faculty! These events are a great opportunity to break the ice, share a few laughs and build meaningful connections outside of the traditional classroom setting by getting students and professors together in a fun, relaxed environment.
- **Lab Visit**:Real physics is about seeing how the work of researchers actually gets done. To provide this necessary exposure, PhySoc organizes visits to labs for junior students only, on a monthly/bi-monthly basis. These guided tours offer learners first-hand look at the daily life of a researcher and the opportunity to see advanced experimental setups up close. Students will have the chance to see the most modern facilities in optics, photonics, ultra-fast optics, condensed matter physics, and semiconductor physics and get an invaluable behind-the-scenes look at how experimental science is brought to life.

### 4. Resources (`https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app/resources/`)
- **Academic Support**: -Adith ASR (Physics, Batch of 2028) has created Kgp Phy'24, a necessary resource platform. The site is supposed to be a living archive of all physics undergraduates of IIT Kharagpur, having a complete collection of course notes, reference books, class tests and study materials. Phy’24 is constantly adding new content as the 2028 batch progresses through the semesters. Big thanks to ASR for building and maintaining this very useful tool to the community! Click on the link below to access the platform.
- **Academic Wing**: a new initiative for second year students and above. PAW promotes peer-to-peer learning by encouraging senior-led discussions on specialized research topics between seniors and juniors. In addition to these research deep dives, we also host regular lectures on fundamental physics concepts, connecting core coursework to cutting edge science.
- **Advising**:If you are a new student, you are strongly encouraged to ask the Physics Undergraduate Major Advisors to add you to the Physics Intended Major Email List and the Physics Central Ed Discussion. Reach out to our physics advisors, they are here to help..

### 5. Sponsors (`https://physoc-iitkgp.vercel.app/sponsors/`)
- If you or your organization would like to support PhySoc, we offer a range of sponsorship opportunities tailored to:

Promote your brand to physics students and the broader university community
Support educational initiatives and student-led projects
Build connections with emerging physicists and STEM talent
